text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Seiun Sky runs in a
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, whaddya know? Looks like I won
quite
spectacularly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, though, I really wasn't
planning
on winning today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just gonna give everyone the
impression I
still needed time to get
back in form.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... You know, my legs just felt
strangely
light while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I kept wondering why, and before I knew
it, I
found myself in first place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like a certain trainer's been subtly
bringing
out my potential.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup! A terrific trainer and class
coach—an
incredible instructor and a
magnificent mentor!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, considering the effort I put
into that
race, how's about we end
practice early today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy. Guess this is what happens
when I get
too good, huh?
choice_data_list: ……余裕そうだし、もうちょっと
